rev_basis: net premium (insurer: net premium income / net premium written)
roe_basis: TTM PAT to owners Q2 FY26-Q1 FY27 / avg equity to owners (Sep-25, Mar-26)
dps_basis: 1 dividend(s) with ex-date 2025-09-25 to 2026-09-25 (NSE corporate actions, file of 2026-09-20); no bonus/split after these ex-dates
shares_basis: 12,650,000,000 shares: paid-up equity capital / face value Rs 10 at 2026-03-31 (capital per filing; face value per NSE corporate actions), x2 for bonus/split after that date (current basis)
notes: BVPS on current share basis (x2 bonus/split after 2026-03-31)
Q1 FY26 units: declared rounding 'Crores' implausible; values read with factor 1e-07 to Rs cr
Q1 FY27: share count x2.00 vs prior quarter = corporate action x2
Q4 FY25 units: declared rounding 'Crores' implausible; values read with factor 1e-07 to Rs cr
equity = share capital + reserves & surplus (excl. fair-value change account)
